_comment: `native/**` is excluded ON PURPOSE and permanently. It is the Windows quality gate: `npx tsc --noEmit` must never see iOS-only TypeScript, because that tree imports packages (ampora-ignition, react-native-device-activity) that are not installed here. To typecheck the native tree on a Mac after `npm run native:on`, use `tsconfig.native.json` (`npm run typecheck:native`).
